sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Multi-table pages with sticky filter bars: opening a sub-table (e.g. "Album + Compilation + Live" on an artist's release groups) could make the whole page flicker until the section was closed again or the page scrolled. The h3 bars' shared height was rounded up from a measurement with a tiny rounding error (22.0001 px), so it switched between 22 and 23 px on every frame; the measurement is now snapped to 1/100 px first.
